notes.title: The Evolution of Our Capsule Art – 3 Versions Later
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]
Just wanted to share a little behind-the-scenes on the capsule [b]art[/b] for Celestial Return. Over the past year and a half, I ended up redrawing it three times, mostly because I couldn’t quite settle on a look that felt right for the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759856/e62a2b0c7dd913b2a7bb59f89f1cfe87146cc4e2.png"][/img][/p][p]The first version was too safe. It didn’t really capture the weird, noir atmosphere we were going for.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759856/eb1de3cc097c07d9d3e0039a22a8b28298b52f1d.png"][/img]
With the second one, I tried something more minimal and leaned into the cyberpunk vibe. It looked cooler, but still felt a bit off.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759856/7b7eb8b85a9c2aed015dae99ecfc520fddd59422.png"][/img][/p][p]The third version is where I think things finally clicked. I focused more on visual storytelling, bold shapes, and making sure it feels like the game, not just looks like it.[/p][p]
I definitely learned a lot from going through all these iterations.[/p][p]
(And yeah, sorry about the lower resolution on the first two. I didn’t keep the high-res versions 😅)[/p][p]
Would love to hear what you think of the progression![/p][p]Kerem Akman – Layer Abuser[/p]

notes.title: CELESTIAL RETURN: BIG UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve been quiet… but for good reason. We just dropped a [b]major update[/b] for Celestial Return, and it’s packed with changes you’ve gotta see. 

[b]WHAT’S NEW?[/b]

🔹[b]Updated Dice Mechanics[/b] – We’ve made some huge changes to the dice system, to make it way more strategic. Dice aren’t just luck anymore, they’re currency.
🔹 [b]Fresh UI [/b]– We stripped the clutter. Everything’s smoother, sharper, and way less “what-do-I-click-again?

Thanks for hanging in there while we made these upgrades!

As always, let us know what you think, we’re all ears. 

Cheers,

[b]P.S. [/b]More tweaks are coming (we’re never done). Jump in our [url=https://discord.gg/CcDnmdwngV][Discord][/url] to rant, rave, or roast us. We’ll listen.

notes.title: Demo Feedback & What We’re Working On
notes.notes:
It's been 15 days since we released the demo for Celestial Return, and the response has been incredible! We've received a ton of feedback from all of you, and we're excited to share what we're working on to make the game even better. Here’s what’s coming:

1️⃣ MORE CONTENT:
We’re adding new story arcs, side quests, and extending the gameplay with a full first act. 

2️⃣ GAME MECHANICS:
We’re revamping the dice system. Now, the items you collect will influence your rolls.

3️⃣ OVERWORLD UPDATE:
Look out for new collectible items, cool overworld events, and faster character movement, just like you asked.

4️⃣ KNOWN ISSUES:
We’re fixing those annoying UI issues related to screen size and adding a load/save system for smoother gameplay.

We’re excited to get these updates out to you soon.  Keep the suggestions coming and stay tuned for more news!

Thanks again for all the love and feedback!  ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759856/1818a498fff359a1d698e2c766178fa6d3407250.png[/img]

notes.title: OUR FIRST OST "Celestial Abyss" IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear friends! 

We're excited to share the official release of "Celestial Abyss," our very first soundtrack designed for our indie visual novel game, "Celestial Return." 

"Celestial Abyss" is now available on all major music streaming platforms,  The soundtrack features a unique blend of ambient and jazz elements, and serves as the distinctive theme for our game's detective narrative. 

To all our amazing supporters, don't forget to add "Celestial Abyss" to your favorite playlists.

Thank you for being part of our journey.
